#598 · Thorn Pod Pokémon

Ferrothorn

Grass Steel

Unova · Generation 5

Ferrothorn is a Grass/Steel-type Thorn Pod Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 110 kg. It evolves from Ferroseed. Its highest base stat is Defense (131), with a base stat total of 489.
